message.peepo.tooltip: Use on solid ground to meet a tiny friendly frog.
message.peepo.limit: There are already eight Peepos nearby.
message.peepo.space: Peepo needs clear space above solid ground.
tooltip.peepo_companion.uniform: Equip in a Peepo or Jughead Costume slot. One uniform at a time; tools stay in Hand.
item.peepo_companion.farmer_uniform.bonu: 15% faster planting and harvesting; 15% less crop-work energy. 15% chance for one extra crop item per harvest.
item.peepo_companion.fisherman_uniform.b: 15% shorter bite waits; 20% less fishing energy. 15% chance to double a fish catch; treasure is not duplicated.
item.peepo_companion.chef_uniform.bonus: 20% faster timed kitchen preparation; 10% less kitchen work and delivery energy. 15% chance to double newly cooked, candy or cutting-board results. Containers and sealed-only preserves are not multiplied.
item.peepo_companion.mechanic_uniform.bo: 25% less energy assisting industrial machines and workshop benches. Existing machine speed limits stay unchanged.
item.peepo_companion.porter_uniform.bonu: 25% less delivery energy. Move 25% faster while carrying an active job delivery. Inventory remains eight slots.
item.peepo_companion.baker_uniform.bonus: 20% faster oven loading/unloading; 20% less Hearth Oven delivery energy. Baking time is unchanged.
20% faster shearing/milking; 15% less livestock-work energy. Animal cooldowns are unchanged.
item.peepo_companion.beekeeper_uniform.b: 20% less hive-harvest energy. Smoke is still required; smoked harvests do not provoke bees. No general sting immunity.
item.peepo_companion.runner_uniform.bonu: 15% less energy while running the Generator Wheel or Hand Crank. Output and storage limits are unchanged.
item.peepo_companion.alchemist_uniform.b: 20% faster loaded brewing/crucible deliveries; 20% less delivery energy. Native brewing time and fuel are unchanged.
item.peepo_companion.orchard_keeper_unif: 20% faster fruit/tap collection and loaded orchard/tap/cider deliveries; 15% less matching work/delivery energy. No extra yields.
item.peepo_companion.groundskeeper_unifo: 20% faster water filling and loaded water/sprinkler deliveries; 20% less water, sprinkler-delivery, soil-repair and fertilizing energy.
